newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet fuel propelled higher by futures.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet fuel propelled higher by futures.

text.p: NWE jet fuel was strong on Tuesday as benchmark IPE futures staged a late recovery and premiums remained firm, traders said.
On the cif cargo market, premiums were put at Sept IPE +$33/+$35 a tonne.
There was talk that a U.S. trader was considering shipping some 27,000 tonnes of Venezuelan jet fuel into Europe at a premium of roughly Oct IPE +$39.
Traders said most arbitraged material would find its way into the Med where the shortage of available material was more acute. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7724
